fig5-h3: Within their own study, 49 of 68 predictions reach a held-out AUC of 0.80 or more

fig7-div-ts: Shown: every untested question at 0.80 or more, highest first. Hollow: fewer than 20 test samples. Every 1.000 shows its 95% CI;  Hover a dot for its tumour stage.
page-h1: P2G provides robust liquid biopsy prediction across all analyte types.
page-p-lede: P2G builds a predictive model directly from the raw sequencing reads of each sample: alignment performed after model predictions, no gene list. The analysis is performed with the same modeling, no difference between RNA or DNA, between or base-conversion or native nucleic acid sequences. No study-specific optimization. All predictions are reported on data never seen during training.
